# Premier Heating & Cooling

> Premier Heating & Cooling is a heating, cooling and indoor air quality contractor based in Strathroy, Ontario, serving Strathroy, London, St. Thomas and the surrounding Middlesex and Elgin county towns. A Lennox authorized dealer and TSSA-registered contractor trusted by local home builders, it is part of the Jayden's Mechanical family.

- Legal name: Premier Heating & Cooling
- Home base: 176 Metcalfe St E, Strathroy, Ontario, N7G 1P6, Canada
- Parent: Jayden's Mechanical (https://jaydensmechanical.com)
- Phone: (519) 245-5945
- Email: info@premierheating.ca
- Credentials: Lennox authorized dealer; TSSA registered
